iti37:1.1: This was said by the Blessed One, said by the Arahant, so I have heard:
iti37:2.1: “Endowed with two things, monks, a monk lives full of ease in the here-&-now and is appropriately aroused for the ending of the effluents.
iti37:2.3: A sense of urgency toward things that should inspire urgency and, feeling urgency, appropriate exertion.
iti37:2.4: Endowed with these two things, a monk lives full of ease in the here-&-now and is appropriately aroused for the ending of the effluents.”
iti37:3.2:
Feeling urgency right here
toward what should inspire urgency,
the wise,
iti37:4.4:
would attain the ending
of suffering & stress.
